tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Cambio’s quote for swapping one crypto asset to another, for an exact amount sent or an exact amount to receive, with how it compares to other exchanges. For someone who wants to swap, convert or exchange crypto, asks how much they would receive, or asks how much they need to send to get an amount.

tools.name: gas_help
tools.description: Explains which coin pays network fees ("gas") on a chain and how to get a little of it, for someone whose tokens are stuck because the wallet holds none of that coin (for example USDT on Tron with no TRX). Chains: tron, bsc, solana, ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, avalanche.

tools.name: track_swap
tools.description: Shows the status of a Cambio swap: deposit, confirming, exchanging, payout, each with its time. Needs the order number AND the address the customer is receiving to (the payout address they gave when creating the swap), the same check cambio.one makes. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Cambio’s quote for swapping an exact amount of one crypto asset to another, with how it compares to other exchanges. For someone who wants to swap, convert or exchange crypto, or asks how much they would receive. Each leg takes its network (for example tron, bsc, ethereum, arbitrum, solana, bitcoin)" → after: "Cambio’s quote for swapping one crypto asset to another, for an exact amount sent or an exact amount to receive, with how it compares to other exchanges. For someone who wants to swap, convert or exchange crypto, asks how much they would receive, or asks how much they need to send to get an amount. "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
